A shopper is briefly very close to the camera wearer—roughly within arm’s reach—and crosses the wearer’s forward path while facing toward the clothing displays. Clothing racks and sale signage are directly ahead; a mobile phone showing clothing listings is also within the wearer’s reach. The shopper is not clearly photographing anything, and nothing suggests a major purchase awaiting a call. Given the phone-based comparison and visible sale sign, the most appropriate action is to compare prices and mention the possible discount.
